_comment: Third leg of the Wirewood Lodge human-play rule (2026-08-24): the {G} may be funded by the turn's LAND DROP, and the option must still be offered. Same board as stompy_lodge_untap_hidden.json -- untapped Lodge, tapped Elvish Archdruid, tapped Forest, no untapped green source -- plus a FOREST IN HAND with the land drop unused, so 'play Forest, tap it for {G}, tap the Lodge, untap the Archdruid' is a legal line. This exists because c4153b0e's (now removed) human-play trial-pay probed the PRE-cast state, and a gate of that shape can only be sound if the land drop is already applied when CollectActions runs. It is -- EnumeratePlansWithLand plays the land first -- and this pins that, so any future affordability gate added at this emission has to keep it true. Fails as legal_not_enumerated the moment something prices the untap before the land.
